items.title: FedRAMP’s Consolidated Rules for 2026: What cloud service providers need to know
items.summary: FedRAMP's Consolidated Rules for 2026 (CR26), effective July 2026, change how cloud service providers achieve and maintain FedRAMP certifications and give federal agencies more autonomy. This guide covers CR26's impact, new CSP responsibilities, and how to operationalize compliance on AWS GovCloud (US) and the AWS US East and US West Regions.
items.creator: Brian Stucker
